game_title: Type Cast Forge – Magma Forge Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round, fire sprites strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from fire sprites in Magma Forge: keep the forge_heat meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: forge_heat drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while forge_heat > 0.
